top_signals.title: 500m bricks ‘just sitting there’ as 1.5m homes target looms
top_signals.summary: There are half a billion bricks lying unused in Britain, it has been revealed, piling fresh pressure on the government’s “stretch target” of building 1.5m homes by the next election.
